violation_type.title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers of Groups Not Combined Not Additional (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers of Groups Not Combined Not Additional
violation_type.typical_finding: All caregivers observed during naptime, were counted in ratio. There was not another person observed in the building when I arrived.

finding_variants.text: All caregivers observed during naptime, were counted in ratio. There was not another person observed in the building when I arrived.
At the nap time, there were no additional caregivers/staff in the building until the owner/caregiver caregiver came back to the building.
